title: Why most product tours get skipped
summary: An article exploring why users skip product tours during software onboarding, likely analyzing common UX mistakes and user behavior patterns that lead to low engagement with guided tours.
problem_solved: Helps product teams understand why users ignore in-app tutorials and onboarding flows.
why_valuable: Improves user adoption and engagement by teaching teams to design more effective, non-intrusive onboarding experiences that users actually complete.
